definitions.explanation: The capacity for learning, reasoning, understanding, and similar forms of mental activity.

examples.english: Research on artificial intelligence is progressing.

notes:
{知能|ちのう} refers to the innate capacity for learning, reasoning, and problem-solving — mental ability rather than acquired knowledge.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{人工|じんこう}{知能|ちのう}→人工知能：04878_jinkouchinou⟧ (AI, artificial intelligence)
- {知能|ちのう}⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧ (intelligence test, IQ test)
- {知能|ちのう}⟦{指数|しすう}→指数：20414_shisuu⟧ (intelligence quotient, IQ)
- {知能|ちのう}⟦{犯|はん}→犯：noentry⟧ (intellectual crime, white-collar crime)
- ⟦{高|こう}→高：noentry⟧{知能|ちのう} (high intelligence)

- {知能|ちのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ (intelligence is high/low)
